name: enfurbish
description: Claude Code plugins by phreakocious: session continuity, project-instruction approval gating, and ambient language learning.

plugins.name: continuity
plugins.description: Intentional session continuity: /wrap retro, /next command, and a SessionStart hook that surfaces NEXT_SESSION.md handoffs.

plugins.name: affirm
plugins.description: Approval gate for project instructions. Surfaces new or modified CLAUDE.md and .claude/rules/* files at session start before Claude treats them as trusted.

plugins.name: pastiche
plugins.description: Ambient language learning. A SessionStart hook weaves vocabulary from your ledger into ordinary sessions — a steady drip tied to the work, not a quiz — and tracks what was last surfaced so stale items come back.
